notes: Each preset is a starting point the planner fills in; every field can be overridden by the brief or a control.
genre_tags are ACE-Step genre words (checked against acestep/genres_vocab.txt of the pinned ACE source).
No preset names an artist, a song or a film: they describe a sound only.
hints are 1-3 word section modifiers used in lyric tags, e.g. [Chorus - soaring strings].

presets.name: Hindi acoustic ballad
presets.blurb: A warm Hindi love song: fingerpicked guitar and felt piano, intimate verses, a chorus that opens up.
presets.genre_tags: Hindi ballad, romantic acoustic pop ballad
presets.vocal: warm expressive vocal singing clear Hindi, intimate low verses and a soaring memorable chorus

lyrics.rhyme: AABB or ABCB with a strong chorus rhyme
lyrics.style: everyday conversational Hindustani, one concrete image per line

presets.name: Bollywood romantic
presets.blurb: A filmi love song: strings and piano, tabla under the verses, a big memorable mukhda.
presets.vocal: emotive playback-style vocal with gentle ornaments, tender antara and a soaring mukhda
presets.wordless: soft female aalap and ooh harmonies

lyrics.style: Hindustani with a light Urdu touch, imagery of moon, rain, rivers, eyes, used sparingly

presets.name: Bollywood dance number
presets.blurb: A festive dance track: dhol and electronic drums, synth hooks, a chant-along chorus.
presets.genre_tags: Bollywood dance-pop, Bollywood EDM, Hindi pop
presets.vocal: bright confident vocal, punchy rhythmic verses and a big chant-along hook

lyrics.rhyme: AABB, heavy repetition of the hook
lyrics.style: short punchy Hindi phrases, playful, a hook of 2 to 4 words repeated

presets.name: Retro filmi
presets.blurb: An old-school film song: big string orchestra, mandolin and accordion, a sweet swinging melody.
presets.genre_tags: retro Bollywood, filmi, vintage Hindi film song
presets.vocal: classic playback vocal with warm vibrato and graceful ornaments

lyrics.style: simple poetic Hindustani, playful or courtly romance

presets.name: Sufi rock

presets.vocal: powerful open-throated vocal with long held notes and ornamented runs

lyrics.style: Sufi imagery of longing for the beloved or the divine, Urdu-tinged Hindustani

presets.name: Qawwali
presets.blurb: Devotional qawwali: harmonium, tabla and handclaps, a lead singer answered by a chorus, rising in intensity.

lyrics.style: Urdu-tinged devotional poetry, a refrain the chorus repeats

presets.name: Ghazal
presets.blurb: An intimate ghazal: harmonium, tabla and sarangi around a gentle, ornamented voice. Each couplet stands alone.
presets.vocal: soft intimate vocal with subtle ornaments and unhurried phrasing

lyrics.rhyme: couplets ending in the same refrain word (radif)
lyrics.style: Urdu-tinged couplets (sher), each self-contained, the second line of the first couplet returns as refrain

presets.name: Bhajan
